description: This Java class, SaddlePointExpansion, provides utility methods for computing probability mass functions and related calculations using saddle point approximation techniques, specifically for binomial distributions. It includes internal methods for Stirling error estimation, deviance calculations, and logarithm of binomial probabilities, based on the work of Catherine Loader.

classes.name: SaddlePointExpansion
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for saddle point expansion calculations, particularly for approximating binomial probabilities and their error estimates.

methods.name: getStirlingError
methods.description: Computes the error term of Stirling's approximation for a given value, using precomputed values for small arguments and an asymptotic expansion for larger arguments.

methods.name: getDeviancePart
methods.description: Calculates the deviance component used in saddle point approximation for binomial probabilities based on the difference between observed and expected counts.

methods.name: logBinomialProbability
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of the binomial probability mass function at a specific point using saddle point techniques, handling special cases for boundary values.
